CustomField.description: The fewest hours between two recalculations of totals on records with very many records under them (the large parent route, R-RQ6), 0 to 24. Saves in between wait and share the next run. Blank or out of range means 1; 0 recalculates as soon as possible (D-200 P2).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How often, at most, totals on a record with very many records under it (a fund every gift goes to) are recalculated.
CustomField.label: Large Parent Hours
